text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... I'm eager to make
a new wagashi for my friend's birthday party!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trying this, trying that!
...And as we kept on tasting everything—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, a pimple on my forehead...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...
"Cherry blossom buds are like pimples"... uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trial batches and pimples. It seemed
like a lot of things weren't going well.
